rulings: R75 (2026-09-19, Drew): 2026 Bowman Mega Box (key bowman-mega) and 2026 Bowman Chrome Mega Box (key bowman-chrome-mega-box) are TWO products with the same card numbers and different players. Verified rosters: PR #2319, backend/data/checklists/scraped/acq-2026-09-19-beckett-bowman-mega-box-2026/*.csv (268 rows) and .../acq-2026-09-19-beckett-bowman-chrome-mega-box-2026/*.csv (265 rows).

Verdict per sale is decided from the TITLE using, in priority order: (a) title/player-name vs the two rosters at that card number; (b) a BCP number >= 152 is exclusively Chrome Mega Box range (plain Mega Box's own BCP prospect numbering runs BCP-1..BCP-151); (c) the words 'Chrome Mega' in the title; (d) Chrome Mega Box released ~2026-09-23 (Beckett file dated 2026-08-19) so any sale observed/sold before 2026-09-01 cannot be Chrome Mega Box; plain Mega Box released 2026-05-27.

ORCHESTRATOR RULING 2026-09-19 confirming evidence order: roster (a) and pre-release date (d) beat title wording (c) -- existing doctrine, 'the roster decides'. Plain Mega Box cards ARE chrome-stock Mojo Refractor parallels, so the words 'Chrome Mega' in a title are NOT evidence of the Chrome Mega Box product; (c) is used only when (a), (b) and (d) are all silent.

HELD OUT of this list entirely (not RELOCATE/REPOINT, not UNDECIDED -- a distinct category, see `heldOut`): BCP-151 (132 sale rows) -- the exact boundary card, Mega's own BCP numbering ends there and Chrome's begins there; and the three shared numbers where BOTH rosters name the SAME player, so roster evidence can never disambiguate: #17 Francisco Lindor (73 sale rows), CRA-BE Bryce Eldridge (0 sale rows observed), CRA-RA Roman Anthony (0 sale rows observed).
UNDECIDED (excluded, distinct from held-out): 1 sale, card #89, not present in either committed roster at any prefix -- no evidence at all.

RELOCATE is used only when the sale's cardId (the sold_comps partition key, container is partitioned on /cardId) is itself an hiq:...:bowman-mega:/hiq:...:bowman-chrome-mega-box: slug naming the wrong product -- this is a true partition move. REPOINT is used when cardId is not a mis-partitioned hiq slug for this product pair (most rows: cardId is a raw external id such as a CardHedge card_id or an untouched hiq:...:bowman: id) but hobbyiqCardId (the field the pricing/read path uses to route a sale to a card) names the wrong product; only hobbyiqCardId needs correcting in place.

Destination changes ONLY the product segment (index 3 of the colon-delimited hiq id: hiq:sport:year:PRODUCT:cardNumber:parallel:isAuto[:...]); cardNumber, parallel, isAuto and any grade/printRun suffix are carried through unchanged, per 'a relocation list changes only the ruled axis'.

Order of operations for the wider R75 program: (1) apply THIS sales list; (2) apply the companion catalog reslug list (2026-09-19-r75-bowman-mega-box-catalog-reslug.json via relocate-catalog-rows-by-list) moving the 4,825 crossed checklistinsider/beckett/hobbymonitor rungs from bowman-chrome-mega-box to bowman-mega; (3) ingest the corrected Chrome Mega Box checklist package into the now-freed bowman-chrome-mega-box ids.
